headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.40
summary: Synced upstream: the news and account screens were redesigned, the in-game mod menu picked up palette themes, and Microsoft sign-in got sturdier timeouts and clearer offline behaviour.

items.text: The news screen has a new layout with cleaner cards and a tighter header, and the account screens follow the same design language.
The avatar in the navigation bar now opens a reworked account switcher, and switching accounts no longer needs a full launcher restart.
The in-game mod menu offers palette themes, so its panel can match the launcher accent instead of one fixed colour.

Launching with the launcher-managed login while offline now says whether it is reusing saved credentials or continuing signed out, instead of failing with a vague error. Microsoft sign-in also retries and times out more sensibly on flaky connections.
